objections.requirement: Missing evidence: the study is 'planned' and evidence_ids is empty. Neither claim (C-Q1-001.physics, C-Q1-001.hybrid) can receive a verdict until all three required arms have run on the val split (fingerprint edfcc32d…) and per-row predictions are recorded for the paired diagnostics S-Q1-001.paired_physics and S-Q1-001.paired_hybrid.
objections.author: critic-002

objections.requirement: Uncertainty procedure is unspecified, but both claims set requires_uncertainty. Pre-register a paired resampling scheme over validation rows, such as a paired bootstrap with B ≥ 2000 and a fixed resampling seed. Each resample must recompute the global-Frobenius rel_l2 for both arms on the same rows; averaging per-row errors is not a substitute. The decision rule for 'at least 1% better' must be stated as: the upper confidence bound of rel_l2(treatment)/rel_l2(control) is below 0.99. Also state the confidence level and whether it is corrected for the two claims.
objections.author: critic-002

objections.requirement: Forward-model fidelity must be verified (requires_implementation_verification). Show that the physics and hybrid arms call the same forward operator that generated the data: same 40-point grid, 200 steps, Dirichlet BCs, Gaussian IC at x = 0.5, sensor indices [5, 15, 25, 35] and observation times. Also show the mapping of the 4 segments to grid cells and how conductivity is evaluated at interfaces in the divergence-form stencil. Evidence: for a sample of val rows, the residual at the true parameters should give a chi-square consistent with 80 × sigma² (about 8e-5). Any mismatch invalidates the comparison.
objections.author: critic-002

objections.requirement: Explicit-FD stability must hold over the full search region. Report dt·k_max/dx² against the 0.5 stability limit at k = 2.0 and at any iterate the optimizer can reach. If log-space LM iterates are not projected or clipped to [log 0.5, log 2], unstable forward solves can produce NaN or exploding misfits that silently corrupt results. State the bound-handling method (projection, clipping, or reparameterization) and the treatment of NaN evaluations.
objections.author: critic-002

objections.requirement: Optimizer correctness needs evidence. Provide a Jacobian check (finite-difference versus analytic or adjoint, if analytic is used) and a per-row convergence log: final misfit, iterations used, whether the 30- or 15-iteration cap was hit, and the fraction of rows ending on a bound. The selection rule across multistarts and extra_starts must be minimum data misfit, not proximity to the target, and this needs to be shown. Clarify the role of posterior_samples = 128 when estimator = 'mode'. If those samples feed the point estimate, the arm is not the MAP described in the claim text.
objections.author: critic-002

objections.requirement: Hybrid isolation: the claim attributes any gain to the LM refinement, so the hybrid's initializer must be the identical fitted ET model used in control_et. That means the same seed, the same training rows (fingerprint cdad4859…), the same augmentation draws, scaler and log transform. Either share the artifact or show bitwise-identical predictions. Otherwise the paired difference mixes ET refitting variance with the LM effect.
objections.author: critic-002

objections.requirement: The control's noise augmentation configuration is unspecified. The contract lists observation_noise_augmentation first in transform_order, but the control arm gives no noise_scale or copy count. Record the exact values, or 'none', so that the control is reproducible and the matched comparison is well defined.
objections.author: critic-002

objections.requirement: Forward-evaluation budget accounting is missing. Count evaluations per row: residuals plus the finite-difference Jacobian (about 5 solves per iteration for 4 parameters), × iterations × starts, plus posterior_samples if they are evaluated. Multiply by the validation row count and show the total stays under max_forward_evals = 3,000,000. Do this separately for the two arms and include any reruns, since debugging runs also consume the budget.
objections.author: critic-002

objections.requirement: Held-out discipline: confirm that no settings were selected using the test split (fingerprint aa096404…) or stress data. This covers iters, multistart count, extra_starts, the tikhonov = 0 choice and ET hyperparameters. If any of these were tuned on val, the val-based claim is optimistic and this must be disclosed. A final test confirmation should be a separate, single-shot evaluation.
objections.author: critic-002

objections.requirement: Inverse-crime scope: if the inversion uses exactly the data-generating discretization and the exact known noise model, the result shows performance under a perfectly specified model. The synthesis should scope the claim this way and not generalize to robustness against model error. A mismatched-discretization check would be informative but is not required for the claims as written.
objections.author: critic-002

objections.requirement: Seed variability: each arm runs at a single seed (0). ET seed variance, and for physics_map the multistart initialization seed, should be characterized with a few additional seeds, or acknowledged as a source of uncertainty the row bootstrap does not capture. This matters most if the observed improvement is close to the 1% margin.
objections.author: critic-002

objections.requirement: Per-target analysis: rel_l2 pools all four conductivities, so a gain could come from well-observed interior segments while edge segments next to the Dirichlet boundaries degrade. S-Q1-001.per_target_hybrid is optional, and there is no per-target diagnostic for physics_map. Report per-target rel_l2 or R² for both treatments before any synthesis statement about 'recovering the four conductivities'.
objections.author: critic-002

objections.requirement: Terminology and prior consistency: with tikhonov = 0 and a uniform prior, the 'MAP' estimate is a bound-constrained maximum-likelihood estimate in log-k. That is only valid if the bounds are actually enforced. Note also that a uniform prior on k is not uniform in log-k, so if any prior term is applied in log space it needs a Jacobian correction. The claim text should describe the estimator accurately.
objections.author: critic-002

objections.requirement: Local Fisher or identifiability statements, if made in synthesis, must stay within the contract's limits. They describe local sensitivity under the assumed noise and prior, not global identifiability. Multistart agreement or disagreement per row should be reported as the evidence about multimodality, rather than as a Fisher-based claim.
objections.author: critic-002

objections.requirement: The synthesis should report compute cost alongside accuracy: forward evaluations and wall-clock time per row for physics and hybrid, versus ET inference. The claims concern rel_l2 only and should not be expanded into an overall superiority claim.
objections.author: critic-002

objections.requirement: Forward-model parity must be verified before any claim is evaluated. The physics and hybrid arms must reproduce the simulator's noise-free observations for the same k to near machine precision. The check covers the same 40-point grid, 200 explicit steps, homogeneous Dirichlet ends, the same Gaussian initial condition at x=0.5, and the same sensor indices [5,15,25,35] at the same discrete times. It must also cover the same interface treatment for piecewise-constant k in divergence form, for example harmonic or arithmetic face averaging. If any of these differ, the stated inverse-crime scope is false and the comparison is misattributed.
objections.author: critic-002

objections.requirement: Report explicit-scheme stability across the full bound box. Show that dt <= dx^2/(2*k_max) holds for k up to 2.0, and also for any trial k the optimizer may evaluate during line search or LM steps before projection. Non-finite or unstable forward solves must be logged per row.
objections.author: critic-002

objections.requirement: Pre-specify how failed rows are handled: optimizer failures, NaN or Inf residuals, and non-convergence. Every validation row must receive a prediction from every arm, with fallbacks declared in advance, or else failure counts must be reported. Rows must not be silently dropped, since that would break pairing and bias rel_l2.
objections.author: critic-002

objections.requirement: The uncertainty procedure required by requires_uncertainty=true is not specified. Pre-register the following: the number of validation rows; the paired resampling scheme, such as a row-level paired bootstrap of the rel_l2 ratio, with B and CI level; the decision rule for at_least_better (upper CI bound of treatment/control rel_l2 ratio < 0.99); and, for the equivalence claim, a TOST-style rule with the exact margin definition. The margin definition must state whether the ratio is hybrid/physics in [0.99, 1.01] or uses an absolute difference relative to physics rel_l2.
objections.author: critic-002

objections.requirement: The registered question asks whether the hybrid is equivalent 'while using fewer forward evaluations', but no claim, metric, or diagnostic measures forward-evaluation counts. Add per-row accounting of forward evaluations for each arm: residual evaluations, Jacobian evaluations including finite-difference perturbations, rejected LM steps, and all starts. Report total use against the 3,000,000 budget. Without this, the efficiency half of the question cannot appear in any synthesis.
objections.author: critic-002

objections.requirement: Matched-control integrity for the hybrid: verify that the hybrid's ET initializer predictions on validation are identical to the S-Q1-002.control_et predictions. The initializer must use the same fitted model, seed 0, log target, and standard scaler. Otherwise C-Q1-002.hybrid does not isolate the effect of LM refinement.
objections.author: critic-002

objections.requirement: Convergence diagnostics for both inversion arms are needed so that performance differences can be attributed correctly. For each row, report: final misfit compared with the misfit at the true k (which should be about n_obs*sigma^2 if the global optimum is found); the fraction of rows converged within the iteration cap (30 for MLE, 15 for hybrid); the number of distinct minima across starts; and the fraction of estimates at or near the [0.5, 2.0] bounds. Without these, a non-equivalence result cannot be separated into an iteration-cap effect, a local-minimum effect, or an initialization effect.
objections.author: critic-002

objections.requirement: Specify the implementation of bound handling and the Jacobian. State how bounds are enforced in log-k (projection, clipping, or reparameterization) and how the Jacobian is computed (adjoint, forward sensitivity, or finite differences with a stated step). For finite differences, the step must be justified relative to sigma=0.001 and to solver precision. These choices change both accuracy and forward-evaluation counts.
objections.author: critic-002

objections.requirement: Document the provenance of the re-registration. State whether S-Q1-001 validation results informed any S-Q1-002 choices, such as iteration counts, multistart counts, extra_starts, or the 1% margin. If they did, the validation split is no longer a clean confirmatory set for these claims, and this must be disclosed. Test and stress splits must remain untouched.
objections.author: critic-002

objections.requirement: Clarify the estimator settings. The physics and hybrid arms specify estimator='mode' with posterior_samples=128. State whether posterior sampling is performed or ignored. State whether the uniform prior with tikhonov=0 makes 'mode' exactly the bounded MLE. The reported estimator must match the claim text ('maximum-likelihood').
objections.author: critic-002

objections.requirement: Report the per-target diagnostics alongside the global result. Global-Frobenius rel_l2 on raw k is weighted toward large-k rows and toward the better-identified segments. The outer segments may be weakly informed, given a centred initial pulse, decay toward the Dirichlet boundaries, and a finite observation window. Per-target results should not be summarized away, and any local Fisher or conditioning analysis must be labelled as local sensitivity only, not as global identifiability.
objections.author: critic-002

objections.requirement: Seed and optimizer randomness is not represented in the confirmatory uncertainty. Row-level bootstrap captures validation sampling only, not ET training randomness or multistart initialization randomness. The seed-1 arms are optional, and there is no seed-1 hybrid. Any synthesis must either state that its conclusions are conditional on seed 0, or run the seed replicates and report between-seed spread relative to the 1% margin. This matters most for the equivalence claim.
objections.author: critic-002

objections.requirement: Limit the scope of any synthesis. All results hold only in the inverse-crime setting: an exact forward model, a known initial condition, and known Gaussian noise with sigma=0.001. They must not be generalized to model misspecification, other noise levels, other discretizations, or other sensor layouts, because none of these were tested.
objections.author: critic-002

objections.requirement: Certification: claim verdicts must be issued by an independent verifier from the logged per-row predictions and forward-evaluation logs, not self-certified by the executing agent. The evidence_ids list is currently empty, and no evidence yet supports any claim.
objections.author: critic-002

objections.requirement: C-Q1-001.physics: the verdict is inconclusive because noise_aug, noise_scale and target_transform vary between arms but were not registered as allowed. These differences are structural: the physics arm has no library preprocessing fields, the control's noise_aug=0 and noise_scale=1.0 were inserted by normalization, and the log transform sits in physics params.transform. Register a new claim version that adds these factors to allowed_varying_factors, with this justification attached. Record it as a disclosed protocol deviation made after results were seen, not as the original preregistration. The verdict must then be re-issued from the existing paired evidence (resu-00055, resu-00051).
objections.author: critic-002

objections.requirement: C-Q1-001.hybrid: the matcher flags features, method, scaler, pca, noise_aug, noise_scale and target_transform. This looks like a schema artifact: the hybrid nests the extra_trees config under 'init', so top-level fields appear absent. Show that the hybrid's effective init config is identical to the control's effective config by hashing it and comparing against 170e334e…. Also state whether the hybrid reuses the control's fitted ET model or refits it with the same seed and training rows. Then either map init.* to the control fields in merge_mappings or register a new claim version. Until then the hybrid-vs-ET comparison is not a matched control.
objections.author: critic-002

objections.requirement: Both claims set requires_implementation_verification=true, but every arm has method_contract.diagnostics.verified=false, no declared or observed diagnostics, and source_hash=null. The inference policy requires exported-artifact certification. Provide source hashes and certified exported artifacts for all three arms. Also provide an independent check of the physics forward/inverse code, for example a noiseless synthetic round-trip recovering known conductivities to near machine or solver tolerance. No verdict can be supported before this exists.
objections.author: critic-002

objections.requirement: The physics and hybrid treatments are nearly identical. Their rel_l2 values are 0.0193229 and 0.0193299; per-sample squared errors agree to about 1e-9 on the first rows; p90 values are bit-identical. Either both converge to the same optimum or they share code or outputs. Show that resu-00055 and resu-00053 are separate computations, for example with per-row forward-eval counts and start points. Synthesis must not attribute any hybrid gain to the ET initialization. Doing so would need an ablation of the hybrid with extra_starts=0, since the extra start may be what drives convergence.
objections.author: critic-002

objections.requirement: The claim text says 'Physics MAP', but tikhonov=0 and the arm label is 'physics-MLE'. Under the i.i.d. uniform prior, the mode equals MAP only if the bounds [0.5, 2.0] are enforced during optimization rather than ignored or clipped afterwards. Document how bounds are handled, and either rename the claim to MLE or verify that the estimator is the bounded posterior mode.
objections.author: critic-002

objections.requirement: The uncertainty interval only covers row resampling (200 bootstrap draws) conditional on single seed-0 fitted models. It excludes variation from the ET training seed and from the multistart RNG. The interval lower bound (about 0.728 relative) is far above the 0.01 margin, so this is unlikely to flip the verdict. Still, report results across at least a few seeds, or explicitly scope the claim as conditional on seed 0.
objections.author: critic-002

objections.requirement: Data are generated by the same simulator used for inversion: same 40-point grid, 200 explicit steps, known initial condition and known noise model. Physics-arm superiority is therefore an 'inverse crime' result under a perfectly specified forward model. Synthesis must scope the claim to the well-specified setting and not generalize to model misspecification, unknown initial conditions, or different discretizations.
objections.author: critic-002

objections.requirement: The control is one untuned extra_trees configuration on raw features, with no noise augmentation and no PCA. Synthesis must not generalize the result to 'forward-model inversion beats library regressors'. The supported claim is limited to this specific ET configuration.
objections.author: critic-002

objections.requirement: Error is concentrated in the end segments. Treatment RMSE is about 0.035 for targets 1 and 4 versus about 0.007 for targets 2 and 3, and the worst row has squared error 0.0436. Provide two things. First, a per-target diagnostic for the physics arm; one currently exists only for the hybrid. Second, a comparison of per-target error against the local Fisher / Cramér–Rao scale at sigma=0.001, to tell noise-limited error from local-minimum or non-convergence failures. Include a list of rows where the best of the 3 starts did not converge. Per the contract, Fisher results are local diagnostics only.
objections.author: critic-002

objections.requirement: Report the actual number of forward evaluations used by the physics and hybrid arms, in total and per row. Confirm the total is within max_forward_evals=3,000,000. Report wall-clock cost alongside accuracy, since the hybrid (about 27.3 s estimated) costs more than physics (about 17.3 s) with no measurable accuracy gain.
objections.author: critic-002

objections.requirement: Document that iters (30 and 15), multistart=3 and extra_starts=1 were fixed before the validation results were seen. Confirm that no test or stress observations informed any choice. If any settings were tuned on validation, the 750 validation rows are not an unbiased estimate, and a held-out confirmation is needed before final claims.
objections.author: critic-002

objections.requirement: No claim comparing the hybrid against the physics arm is registered or tested. Their difference (about 7e-6 in rel_l2) has no interval. Synthesis must not rank the two treatments against each other.
objections.author: critic-002

objections.requirement: Implementation verification is missing for all three claims, and each claim sets requires_implementation_verification=true. In every arm the method_contract shows diagnostics.verified=false, the declared and observed diagnostic lists are empty, and source_hash=null. The inference_policy says repeatability requires exported-artifact certification, and none is supplied. Provide a source hash for the physics/LM and hybrid code, an exported-artifact certification, and declared-versus-observed diagnostics before any claim leaves 'inconclusive'.
objections.author: critic-002

objections.requirement: The registered question asks whether the hybrid is equivalent 'while using fewer forward evaluations', but no forward-evaluation counts, wall-clock times, or Jacobian-evaluation counts are reported for either arm. The est_seconds values (17.3 for physics_mle, 27.3 for hybrid_lm) are gate estimates, not measurements, and they suggest the hybrid may cost more. Report the measured forward-eval count per row (mean and max) for physics_mle and hybrid_lm. Until then, no synthesis may claim a compute advantage; C-Q1-002.hybrid_equiv_physics can only support accuracy equivalence.
objections.author: critic-002

objections.requirement: Attribution of the hybrid result to the ET initializer is unsupported. The hybrid's per-sample squared errors match physics_mle to about 1e-9 (for example, 0.0017367219887 vs 0.0017367224577) and its per-target RMSEs match to 4 digits. This indicates that both arms converge to the same likelihood optimum regardless of initialization. No ablation is supplied, such as LM with 15 iterations and 2 random or prior-mean starts and no ET init, so the contribution of the ET init is unidentified. Any synthesis implying that the data-driven init improves accuracy is unsupported.
objections.author: critic-002

objections.requirement: Init provenance cannot be verified. C-Q1-002.hybrid states that the initializer uses the 'same configuration and seed as the control'. The configuration hash matches the control (170e334e...), but the hybrid's source_artifacts (resu-00145, resu-00141) do not show that the fitted init model is the same artifact as control_et. Provide the fitted-model identifier or hash used inside hybrid_lm.
objections.author: critic-002

objections.requirement: No optimizer convergence diagnostics are reported for the MLE label. Missing items include the final objective or chi-square per row compared with its expected value (about 80·sigma² = 8e-5 for 80 observations at sigma=0.001), gradient or step norms at termination, the fraction of rows hitting the 30- or 15-iteration cap, the fraction of estimates at the [0.5, 2.0] bounds, and the agreement among the 3 starts. Without these, 'maximum-likelihood' is asserted rather than demonstrated, and local minima cannot be ruled out.
objections.author: critic-002

objections.requirement: There is no efficiency reference against local Fisher information. Per-target RMSE is about 5x larger for the outer segments (0.0356 and 0.0350) than for the inner ones (0.0079 and 0.0065). This is consistent with weaker sensitivity near the Dirichlet boundaries, but it is not checked against a local Fisher/Cramér-Rao bound under sigma=0.001. Per the contract, any such comparison is local only and is not an identifiability guarantee. Without it, the evidence cannot separate estimator suboptimality from intrinsic ill-conditioning.
objections.author: critic-002

objections.requirement: The control is a single untuned ExtraTrees configuration (max_features=0.5, 300 trees, raw features, no noise augmentation, no PCA). The about-75% relative improvement supports only the claim as registered against this specific baseline. Any synthesis generalizing to 'physics inversion beats data-driven methods' would need tuned, stronger, or noise-augmented data-driven controls.
objections.author: critic-002

objections.requirement: The inverse-crime scope must be carried into synthesis. Data generation and inversion share the exact 40-point, 200-step explicit FD forward model and the exact known noise sigma. The claim texts state this scope. Any synthesis must not extend the conclusions to model misspecification, grid mismatch, unknown noise level, or real data, because no stress evidence under misspecification is supplied and held-out stress data cannot be used for this.
objections.author: critic-002

objections.requirement: Uncertainty scope is limited. The bootstrap intervals use n_bootstrap=200, cover only row resampling conditional on fitted models, and exclude training and task seed variation. The seed-1 replicate covers only ET and physics_mle (physics 0.019337 vs 0.019323, ET 0.07711 vs 0.07741), and no seed-1 hybrid arm exists. The margins are far from the intervals, so the verdicts are unlikely to change. Still, the equivalence claim should note that hybrid seed variability is unmeasured, and a larger bootstrap is advisable for tail quantiles.
objections.author: critic-002

objections.requirement: Previously raised objections are not visible here. The verdicts list objection-016 through 022, 024, and 029 as unresolved blocking requirements, but their content and resolution status are not part of the supplied evidence. A verdict update requires explicit resolution records for each of them, and this review cannot adjudicate them.
objections.author: critic-002

objections.requirement: The per-target diagnostics are incomplete for a comparison. S-Q1-002.per_target_physics and per_target_hybrid report per_target_rel_l2 only for the treatment, for example [0.0268, 0.0060, 0.0050, 0.0263]. They give no matching control per-target rel_l2 or per-target paired intervals, so the claim that improvement holds on every target is not directly evidenced. The per_target_rmse values in the paired diagnostics do suggest it does, but without intervals.
objections.author: critic-002

messages.author: researcher-003
messages.question: Q-1
messages.text: Design rationale only; no evidence exists yet, so nothing here is a result. With sigma=0.001, 4 parameters, a known initial condition and an authorized forward model, a likelihood-based inversion should approach the noise floor where the parameters are locally identifiable. A learned regressor trained on 3000 rows is limited by approximation error instead. The log transform enforces positivity and puts the uniform [0.5, 2.0] prior on a better-conditioned scale. Multistart (3) and an extra hybrid start guard against local minima from the discontinuous coefficients. The hybrid arm separates 'good initialization + local refinement' from global physics search. Forward cost is roughly val_rows x starts x iters x (1 + 4 Jacobian evals), which is well under the 3M budget. Wall-clock time (760 s total) is the binding constraint, so torch_mlp is omitted from this first study; it can be added later if extra_trees turns out to be a weak control. The per_target diagnostic on the hybrid arm is optional and feeds Q-2 (outer-segment identifiability). Local Fisher or sensitivity readings must not be read as global identifiability guarantees. Claims are stated for independent verification, not self-certified.

interpretation.interpretation: Task task-001 (specialist-004, artifact resu-00064) failed after 19.4 s of a 60 s limit with 'ValueError: study requires a nonempty stable id'. The specialist reported that its work did not complete. The run produced no measurements, so none of the eight requested diagnostics for S-Q1-002.physics_mle or S-Q1-002.hybrid_lm on the val split (fingerprint edfcc32d..., 750 rows) can be answered from this result. That covers: (1) the Jacobian finite-difference check, (2) the per-row convergence log and the iteration-cap and bound-proximity fractions, (3) the multistart selection rule and cross-start agreement, (4) whether posterior_samples=128 affects the mode estimate, (5) bound handling and the non-finite forward-solve count, (6) the CFL ratio at k=2.0, (7) whether the hybrid initializer matches control_et's val_pred, and (8) forward-evaluation totals against the 3,000,000 budget. The error message suggests the job was rejected at study setup because no study identifier was supplied. This points to a setup or configuration failure rather than a scientific finding about either arm. Nothing here supports or refutes any hypothesis about Q-1. All of these items remain open. The forward evaluations spent by this attempt are unknown and should not be assumed to be zero when the budget total in item 8 is reconciled with resu-00053 and resu-00055. Recommended next step: rerun the same request with a valid stable study id (e.g., S-Q1-002) passed to the study constructor.

No paired-bootstrap result is available for Q-1. Task task-002 (artifact resu-00067, specialist-005) has status 'complete', but its result status is 'missing' with reason 'treatment predictions unavailable'. It ran for 0.0 s against a 60 s limit, so no resampling was done. The requested 95% and Bonferroni-adjusted (alpha=0.05/3) intervals for rel_l2(treatment)/rel_l2(control) in S-Q1-002 were never computed, and the seed-1 arms were not reported separately. This evidence therefore cannot support any decision: not at_least_better (upper bound < 0.99), not equivalent (interval within [0.99, 1.01]), and not worse or inconclusive. Any earlier point estimate of the ratio has no uncertainty quantification from this task. Even if the task had run, its intervals would only have been conditional on the fitted models and would have excluded seed variation. To resolve this, the treatment-arm validation predictions (seed 0 and seed 1) must be made available to the analysis adapter. Then task-002 should be re-run with the same specification (B=2000, seed 0, global-Frobenius rel_l2 recomputed for both arms on each resample). The 'complete' task status should not be read as a successful analysis.

messages.author: researcher-003
messages.question: Q-1
messages.text:
Researcher interpretation, unverified and not self-certified. S-Q1-001 executed all three arms on the same 750 val rows (row_hash 260db427...). The harness returned 'inconclusive' for a protocol reason, not on the evidence: the registered allowed_varying_factors omitted target_transform, noise_aug and noise_scale, and for the hybrid claim also the top-level library fields that move into 'init'. S-Q1-002 re-registers the same configurations with every differing field listed. The control's augmentation is now recorded explicitly as noise_aug=0 and noise_scale=1.0, which addresses objection-007. Claim text now describes the estimator as a bound-constrained log-k MLE (objection-013) and is scoped to the inverse-crime setting (objection-010).

Measured values from S-Q1-001, to be confirmed under the new protocol:
- rel_l2: ET 0.0774, physics 0.01932, hybrid 0.01933.
- Paired relative improvement from a 200-resample bootstrap: about 0.750 [0.729, 0.770] for both treatments. That margin is far from 1%, but B=200 falls short of the pre-registered B≥2000, so S-Q1-002 requests the larger bootstrap.
- Forward-fidelity spot check (200 samples): residual std at truth is 9.95e-4 against nominal 1e-3, model_mismatch=false, chi2/dof about 0.963. This is consistent with objection-003 but is not a full verification of the operator or the segment-to-cell mapping.
- Calibration of the reported posterior std is plausible: 2-sigma coverage 0.957, z_rms 0.98.
- Physics and hybrid agree to about 4e-4 relative in rel_l2 and in per-target errors. This suggests both converge to the same misfit minimum on most rows. The hybrid used about 103k forward evaluations against about 175k for physics, roughly 138 versus 233 per row. Prediction latency was about 11 ms per row versus 19 ms, against 0.14 ms for ET.
- Per-target rel_l2 is similar for physics and hybrid: [0.027, 0.006, 0.005, 0.026]. For ET it is [0.117, 0.028, 0.029, 0.092].

For Q-2 this is local evidence only, not a global identifiability statement. Outer segments 1 and 4 have about 4-5x the error of the interior segments under every method, consistent with weaker sensitivity of the sensor traces near the Dirichlet ends. Blocking objections 004 (CFL/bounds), 005 (Jacobian/convergence/selection rule/posterior_samples role), 006 (initializer identity) and 008 (budget accounting) are not resolved by the existing artifacts and are routed to the coding_execution request. Seed variation (objection-011) is probed with non-required seed-1 arms. Estimated additional cost is about 3 x 20 s plus 2 x 20 s of wall time and about 450k forward evaluations, well within the 709 s and 3M remaining.

interpretation.interpretation:
Task task-003 (specialist-006, artifact resu-00159) failed after 16.9 s of a 60 s limit with 'ValueError: study requires a nonempty stable id'. The specialist reported 'specialist work did not complete'. The request did carry study_id 'S-Q1-002', both in the request body and as a top-level field. So the failure most likely happened in the adapter or study-registration layer, for example a missing or mis-mapped id field, before any computation ran. That cause is inferred from the error text and has not been verified.

None of the eight requested items produced evidence. This covers forward parity and the noiseless round-trip (objections 016 and 032), the stability ratio and max trial k (017), bound handling and the Jacobian finite-difference check (023), convergence diagnostics (022), the selection-rule audit, initializer identity versus control_et (021), forward-evaluation accounting against the 3,000,000 budget (020), and the local CRLB for Q-2. No logs were written for S-Q1-002.

The objections remain open. The arms named in the request (resu-00147, resu-00145, resu-00141, resu-00140) are referenced only. This task does not support or refute any claim about them.

Forward-eval spend for this task is unknown. It is probably near zero, given the early failure, but that is unconfirmed. Any budget tally should carry it as unmeasured rather than zero.

Recommended next step: fix the study-id plumbing so the stable id is populated in the field the adapter checks, then resubmit the identical request. Item (7) should include the spend of the failed attempt, if any can be recovered.

This artifact covers only part of the requested study S-Q1-002. It does not support any verdict on C-Q1-002.physics, C-Q1-002.hybrid or C-Q1-002.hybrid_equiv_physics.

WHAT WAS DELIVERED (pair (a) only: physics_mle vs control_et; sources resu-00147 and resu-00141):
- Rows and hash: n_rows = 750, all values finite. row_hash = 260db427b921…f9295b2, which matches the required prefix 260db427.
- Point estimates: rel_l2(control_et) = 0.077407 and rel_l2(physics_mle) = 0.019323.
- Internal consistency check: sqrt(mean per-row squared error / mean target squared norm) reproduces both values. Control: sqrt(0.041681 / 6.956261) = 0.0774. Treatment: sqrt(0.002597 / 6.956261) = 0.0193. This fits global-Frobenius aggregation.
- Estimand: the result reports relative_improvement = 1 - ratio = 0.75037, with interval [0.72869, 0.77041]. It does not report the requested ratio directly.
- Ratio, derived by me: 0.24963, with interval approximately [0.2296, 0.2713]. Read this as an unadjusted 95% percentile interval; the artifact does not state the interval level.
- Absolute effect: 0.058084, interval [0.054184, 0.062626].
- Per-target RMSE: physics is lower on all 4 targets. Control vs physics: 0.1553 vs 0.0356, 0.0360 vs 0.0079, 0.0375 vs 0.0065, 0.1219 vs 0.0350. These are point values only; no per-target intervals were given.
- Per-row squared error: the physics distribution is much tighter. Max 0.0436 vs 0.653; p90 0.0060 vs 0.114.

DEVIATIONS FROM THE REQUEST:
1. n_bootstrap = 200, not the requested B = 2000. With B = 200, a 98.33% percentile interval rests on about 1.7 resamples per tail, so it would be unstable.
2. No Bonferroni-adjusted interval at alpha = 0.05/3 is reported for any pair. The decision-rule inputs (upper bound below 0.99; interval inside [0.99, 1.01]) are therefore missing.
   - Descriptive note only: the unadjusted ratio interval lies far below 0.99. A rerun with B = 2000 at the adjusted level would likely remain well below 0.99, but this has not been computed or verified.
3. Pairs (b) hybrid_lm vs control_et, (c) hybrid_lm vs physics_mle, and (d) physics_mle_seed1 vs control_et_seed1 are absent. Sources resu-00145, resu-00143 and resu-00140 were not used.
4. The val fingerprint edfcc32d is not reported, so that assertion is unconfirmed. Row-hash agreement is shown only for the two files used.
5. The between-seed rel_l2 differences for ET and for physics, relative to the 1% margin, are not reported.
6. Per-target ratio intervals for (a) and (b) are not reported.
7. Artifact ID mismatch: the task lists artifact_id resu-00163, but its result carries artifact_id resu-00162. Provenance should be reconciled.

SCOPE:
- Per the artifact, all uncertainty is row-sampling only, conditional on the fitted models. It excludes ET training-seed variation and multistart-RNG variation.
- No seed-1 hybrid arm exists, so seed robustness of the hybrid arm cannot be assessed even after the missing pairs are run.

RECOMMENDED FOLLOW-UP:
Rerun the bootstrap on the existing val_pred.npy files with B = 2000 and seed 0, covering all four pairs. Output ratio-scale 95% and 98.33% intervals, the fingerprint check, seed-difference diagnostics and per-target ratio intervals. Then pass these to the reviewer for verdicts.

messages.author: researcher-003
messages.question: Q-1
messages.text:
Researcher interpretation, unverified and not self-certified. Verdicts belong to the independent verifier.

What S-Q1-002 measured. All required arms ran on the same 750 val rows (row_hash 260db427..., n_finite = 750 for every arm). No rows were dropped, so pairing holds. That is a measured count, not the pre-declared fallback rule that objection-018 asks for.

rel_l2 by arm:
- control_et (resu-00141): 0.077407, identical to S-Q1-001. ET at seed 0 is deterministic across reruns.
- physics_mle (resu-00147): 0.019323, identical to S-Q1-001.
- hybrid_lm (resu-00145): 0.019330.
- Seed 1: control_et_seed1 0.077108 (resu-00143) and physics_mle_seed1 0.019337 (resu-00140).

Paired relative improvement over ET (row bootstrap, B=200, conditional on fitted models, excludes seed variation):
- physics: 0.7504 [0.7287, 0.7704] (resu-00149).
- hybrid: 0.7503 [0.7284, 0.7703] (resu-00150).
- seed-1 physics vs seed-1 ET: 0.7492 [0.7267, 0.7692] (resu-00154). This is reported separately and is not pooled.

Hybrid vs physics (resu-00151): relative effect -0.00036 [-0.00126, +0.00021]. That corresponds to a ratio interval of roughly [0.9998, 1.0013], which lies inside the [0.99, 1.01] band. However, B=200 falls short of the pre-registered B >= 2000, and no Bonferroni adjustment has been applied. task-002 is re-issued below for that reason.

Between-seed spread is small relative to the 1% margin:
- physics rel_l2 changes by 1.4e-5 between seeds (about 0.07% relative).
- ET changes by about 0.4%.
- There is still no seed-1 hybrid arm, so the equivalence claim remains conditional on seed 0 (objection-027).

Per-target rel_l2 (resu-00152, resu-00153):
- physics: [0.0268, 0.0060, 0.0050, 0.0263].
- hybrid: [0.0268, 0.0060, 0.0050, 0.0263].
- ET: [0.117, 0.028, 0.029, 0.092].

The outer segments carry about 4-5x the interior error under all three methods. For Q-2 this is local evidence only, not a statement about global identifiability. Whether outer-segment error is noise-limited or optimizer-limited is still open; the local CRLB comparison requested below addresses it.

Compute:
- physics: 174,716 forward evals per run (about 233 per row), 20.3 ms/row.
- hybrid: 103,235 per run (about 138 per row), 11.2 ms/row.
- ET: 0 forward evals, about 0.12 ms/row.

summary: The forward-evaluation counts do not reconcile with the stated design and need an explicit breakdown. physics_mle used 174,716 evals over 750 rows, about 233 per row. The nominal 3 starts × 30 iterations × (1 residual + 4 finite-difference Jacobian solves) would be 450 per row, or 337,500 total. hybrid_lm used about 138 per row against a nominal 2 × 15 × 5 = 150, so it is close to nominal while physics is at about 52%. Possible explanations include per-row early termination (which conflicts with last_iters=cap), a non-FD Jacobian, shared or batched solves, or uncounted calls. Provide per-row residual, Jacobian, rejected-step and start counts, and state which forward calls the counter excludes. The executor's totals may count as partial evidence for objection 020, but the split and this discrepancy must be resolved before the counts support any efficiency statement.

objections.requirement: Missing evidence: the study is 'planned' and evidence_ids is empty. Neither claim (C-Q1-001.physics, C-Q1-001.hybrid) can receive a verdict until all three required arms have run on the val split (fingerprint edfcc32d…) and per-row predictions are recorded for the paired diagnostics S-Q1-001.paired_physics and S-Q1-001.paired_hybrid.
objections.author: critic-002

objections.requirement: Uncertainty procedure is unspecified, but both claims set requires_uncertainty. Pre-register a paired resampling scheme over validation rows, such as a paired bootstrap with B ≥ 2000 and a fixed resampling seed. Each resample must recompute the global-Frobenius rel_l2 for both arms on the same rows; averaging per-row errors is not a substitute. The decision rule for 'at least 1% better' must be stated as: the upper confidence bound of rel_l2(treatment)/rel_l2(control) is below 0.99. Also state the confidence level and whether it is corrected for the two claims.
objections.author: critic-002

objections.requirement: Forward-model fidelity must be verified (requires_implementation_verification). Show that the physics and hybrid arms call the same forward operator that generated the data: same 40-point grid, 200 steps, Dirichlet BCs, Gaussian IC at x = 0.5, sensor indices [5, 15, 25, 35] and observation times. Also show the mapping of the 4 segments to grid cells and how conductivity is evaluated at interfaces in the divergence-form stencil. Evidence: for a sample of val rows, the residual at the true parameters should give a chi-square consistent with 80 × sigma² (about 8e-5). Any mismatch invalidates the comparison.
objections.author: critic-002

objections.requirement: Explicit-FD stability must hold over the full search region. Report dt·k_max/dx² against the 0.5 stability limit at k = 2.0 and at any iterate the optimizer can reach. If log-space LM iterates are not projected or clipped to [log 0.5, log 2], unstable forward solves can produce NaN or exploding misfits that silently corrupt results. State the bound-handling method (projection, clipping, or reparameterization) and the treatment of NaN evaluations.
objections.author: critic-002

objections.requirement: Optimizer correctness needs evidence. Provide a Jacobian check (finite-difference versus analytic or adjoint, if analytic is used) and a per-row convergence log: final misfit, iterations used, whether the 30- or 15-iteration cap was hit, and the fraction of rows ending on a bound. The selection rule across multistarts and extra_starts must be minimum data misfit, not proximity to the target, and this needs to be shown. Clarify the role of posterior_samples = 128 when estimator = 'mode'. If those samples feed the point estimate, the arm is not the MAP described in the claim text.
objections.author: critic-002

objections.requirement: Hybrid isolation: the claim attributes any gain to the LM refinement, so the hybrid's initializer must be the identical fitted ET model used in control_et. That means the same seed, the same training rows (fingerprint cdad4859…), the same augmentation draws, scaler and log transform. Either share the artifact or show bitwise-identical predictions. Otherwise the paired difference mixes ET refitting variance with the LM effect.
objections.author: critic-002

objections.requirement: The control's noise augmentation configuration is unspecified. The contract lists observation_noise_augmentation first in transform_order, but the control arm gives no noise_scale or copy count. Record the exact values, or 'none', so that the control is reproducible and the matched comparison is well defined.
objections.author: critic-002

objections.requirement: Forward-evaluation budget accounting is missing. Count evaluations per row: residuals plus the finite-difference Jacobian (about 5 solves per iteration for 4 parameters), × iterations × starts, plus posterior_samples if they are evaluated. Multiply by the validation row count and show the total stays under max_forward_evals = 3,000,000. Do this separately for the two arms and include any reruns, since debugging runs also consume the budget.
objections.author: critic-002

objections.requirement: Held-out discipline: confirm that no settings were selected using the test split (fingerprint aa096404…) or stress data. This covers iters, multistart count, extra_starts, the tikhonov = 0 choice and ET hyperparameters. If any of these were tuned on val, the val-based claim is optimistic and this must be disclosed. A final test confirmation should be a separate, single-shot evaluation.
objections.author: critic-002

objections.requirement: Inverse-crime scope: if the inversion uses exactly the data-generating discretization and the exact known noise model, the result shows performance under a perfectly specified model. The synthesis should scope the claim this way and not generalize to robustness against model error. A mismatched-discretization check would be informative but is not required for the claims as written.
objections.author: critic-002

objections.requirement: Seed variability: each arm runs at a single seed (0). ET seed variance, and for physics_map the multistart initialization seed, should be characterized with a few additional seeds, or acknowledged as a source of uncertainty the row bootstrap does not capture. This matters most if the observed improvement is close to the 1% margin.
objections.author: critic-002

objections.requirement: Per-target analysis: rel_l2 pools all four conductivities, so a gain could come from well-observed interior segments while edge segments next to the Dirichlet boundaries degrade. S-Q1-001.per_target_hybrid is optional, and there is no per-target diagnostic for physics_map. Report per-target rel_l2 or R² for both treatments before any synthesis statement about 'recovering the four conductivities'.
objections.author: critic-002

objections.requirement: Terminology and prior consistency: with tikhonov = 0 and a uniform prior, the 'MAP' estimate is a bound-constrained maximum-likelihood estimate in log-k. That is only valid if the bounds are actually enforced. Note also that a uniform prior on k is not uniform in log-k, so if any prior term is applied in log space it needs a Jacobian correction. The claim text should describe the estimator accurately.
objections.author: critic-002

objections.requirement: Local Fisher or identifiability statements, if made in synthesis, must stay within the contract's limits. They describe local sensitivity under the assumed noise and prior, not global identifiability. Multistart agreement or disagreement per row should be reported as the evidence about multimodality, rather than as a Fisher-based claim.
objections.author: critic-002

objections.requirement: The synthesis should report compute cost alongside accuracy: forward evaluations and wall-clock time per row for physics and hybrid, versus ET inference. The claims concern rel_l2 only and should not be expanded into an overall superiority claim.
objections.author: critic-002

objections.requirement: Forward-model parity must be verified before any claim is evaluated. The physics and hybrid arms must reproduce the simulator's noise-free observations for the same k to near machine precision. The check covers the same 40-point grid, 200 explicit steps, homogeneous Dirichlet ends, the same Gaussian initial condition at x=0.5, and the same sensor indices [5,15,25,35] at the same discrete times. It must also cover the same interface treatment for piecewise-constant k in divergence form, for example harmonic or arithmetic face averaging. If any of these differ, the stated inverse-crime scope is false and the comparison is misattributed.
objections.author: critic-002

objections.requirement: Report explicit-scheme stability across the full bound box. Show that dt <= dx^2/(2*k_max) holds for k up to 2.0, and also for any trial k the optimizer may evaluate during line search or LM steps before projection. Non-finite or unstable forward solves must be logged per row.
objections.author: critic-002

objections.requirement: Pre-specify how failed rows are handled: optimizer failures, NaN or Inf residuals, and non-convergence. Every validation row must receive a prediction from every arm, with fallbacks declared in advance, or else failure counts must be reported. Rows must not be silently dropped, since that would break pairing and bias rel_l2.
objections.author: critic-002

objections.requirement: The uncertainty procedure required by requires_uncertainty=true is not specified. Pre-register the following: the number of validation rows; the paired resampling scheme, such as a row-level paired bootstrap of the rel_l2 ratio, with B and CI level; the decision rule for at_least_better (upper CI bound of treatment/control rel_l2 ratio < 0.99); and, for the equivalence claim, a TOST-style rule with the exact margin definition. The margin definition must state whether the ratio is hybrid/physics in [0.99, 1.01] or uses an absolute difference relative to physics rel_l2.
objections.author: critic-002

objections.requirement: The registered question asks whether the hybrid is equivalent 'while using fewer forward evaluations', but no claim, metric, or diagnostic measures forward-evaluation counts. Add per-row accounting of forward evaluations for each arm: residual evaluations, Jacobian evaluations including finite-difference perturbations, rejected LM steps, and all starts. Report total use against the 3,000,000 budget. Without this, the efficiency half of the question cannot appear in any synthesis.
objections.author: critic-002

objections.requirement: Matched-control integrity for the hybrid: verify that the hybrid's ET initializer predictions on validation are identical to the S-Q1-002.control_et predictions. The initializer must use the same fitted model, seed 0, log target, and standard scaler. Otherwise C-Q1-002.hybrid does not isolate the effect of LM refinement.
objections.author: critic-002

objections.requirement: Convergence diagnostics for both inversion arms are needed so that performance differences can be attributed correctly. For each row, report: final misfit compared with the misfit at the true k (which should be about n_obs*sigma^2 if the global optimum is found); the fraction of rows converged within the iteration cap (30 for MLE, 15 for hybrid); the number of distinct minima across starts; and the fraction of estimates at or near the [0.5, 2.0] bounds. Without these, a non-equivalence result cannot be separated into an iteration-cap effect, a local-minimum effect, or an initialization effect.
objections.author: critic-002

objections.requirement: Specify the implementation of bound handling and the Jacobian. State how bounds are enforced in log-k (projection, clipping, or reparameterization) and how the Jacobian is computed (adjoint, forward sensitivity, or finite differences with a stated step). For finite differences, the step must be justified relative to sigma=0.001 and to solver precision. These choices change both accuracy and forward-evaluation counts.
objections.author: critic-002

objections.requirement: Document the provenance of the re-registration. State whether S-Q1-001 validation results informed any S-Q1-002 choices, such as iteration counts, multistart counts, extra_starts, or the 1% margin. If they did, the validation split is no longer a clean confirmatory set for these claims, and this must be disclosed. Test and stress splits must remain untouched.
objections.author: critic-002

objections.requirement: Clarify the estimator settings. The physics and hybrid arms specify estimator='mode' with posterior_samples=128. State whether posterior sampling is performed or ignored. State whether the uniform prior with tikhonov=0 makes 'mode' exactly the bounded MLE. The reported estimator must match the claim text ('maximum-likelihood').
objections.author: critic-002

objections.requirement: Report the per-target diagnostics alongside the global result. Global-Frobenius rel_l2 on raw k is weighted toward large-k rows and toward the better-identified segments. The outer segments may be weakly informed, given a centred initial pulse, decay toward the Dirichlet boundaries, and a finite observation window. Per-target results should not be summarized away, and any local Fisher or conditioning analysis must be labelled as local sensitivity only, not as global identifiability.
objections.author: critic-002

objections.requirement: Seed and optimizer randomness is not represented in the confirmatory uncertainty. Row-level bootstrap captures validation sampling only, not ET training randomness or multistart initialization randomness. The seed-1 arms are optional, and there is no seed-1 hybrid. Any synthesis must either state that its conclusions are conditional on seed 0, or run the seed replicates and report between-seed spread relative to the 1% margin. This matters most for the equivalence claim.
objections.author: critic-002

objections.requirement: Limit the scope of any synthesis. All results hold only in the inverse-crime setting: an exact forward model, a known initial condition, and known Gaussian noise with sigma=0.001. They must not be generalized to model misspecification, other noise levels, other discretizations, or other sensor layouts, because none of these were tested.
objections.author: critic-002

objections.requirement: Certification: claim verdicts must be issued by an independent verifier from the logged per-row predictions and forward-evaluation logs, not self-certified by the executing agent. The evidence_ids list is currently empty, and no evidence yet supports any claim.
objections.author: critic-002

objections.requirement: C-Q1-001.physics: the verdict is inconclusive because noise_aug, noise_scale and target_transform vary between arms but were not registered as allowed. These differences are structural: the physics arm has no library preprocessing fields, the control's noise_aug=0 and noise_scale=1.0 were inserted by normalization, and the log transform sits in physics params.transform. Register a new claim version that adds these factors to allowed_varying_factors, with this justification attached. Record it as a disclosed protocol deviation made after results were seen, not as the original preregistration. The verdict must then be re-issued from the existing paired evidence (resu-00055, resu-00051).
objections.author: critic-002

objections.requirement: C-Q1-001.hybrid: the matcher flags features, method, scaler, pca, noise_aug, noise_scale and target_transform. This looks like a schema artifact: the hybrid nests the extra_trees config under 'init', so top-level fields appear absent. Show that the hybrid's effective init config is identical to the control's effective config by hashing it and comparing against 170e334e…. Also state whether the hybrid reuses the control's fitted ET model or refits it with the same seed and training rows. Then either map init.* to the control fields in merge_mappings or register a new claim version. Until then the hybrid-vs-ET comparison is not a matched control.
objections.author: critic-002

objections.requirement: Both claims set requires_implementation_verification=true, but every arm has method_contract.diagnostics.verified=false, no declared or observed diagnostics, and source_hash=null. The inference policy requires exported-artifact certification. Provide source hashes and certified exported artifacts for all three arms. Also provide an independent check of the physics forward/inverse code, for example a noiseless synthetic round-trip recovering known conductivities to near machine or solver tolerance. No verdict can be supported before this exists.
objections.author: critic-002

objections.requirement: The physics and hybrid treatments are nearly identical. Their rel_l2 values are 0.0193229 and 0.0193299; per-sample squared errors agree to about 1e-9 on the first rows; p90 values are bit-identical. Either both converge to the same optimum or they share code or outputs. Show that resu-00055 and resu-00053 are separate computations, for example with per-row forward-eval counts and start points. Synthesis must not attribute any hybrid gain to the ET initialization. Doing so would need an ablation of the hybrid with extra_starts=0, since the extra start may be what drives convergence.
objections.author: critic-002

objections.requirement: The claim text says 'Physics MAP', but tikhonov=0 and the arm label is 'physics-MLE'. Under the i.i.d. uniform prior, the mode equals MAP only if the bounds [0.5, 2.0] are enforced during optimization rather than ignored or clipped afterwards. Document how bounds are handled, and either rename the claim to MLE or verify that the estimator is the bounded posterior mode.
objections.author: critic-002

objections.requirement: The uncertainty interval only covers row resampling (200 bootstrap draws) conditional on single seed-0 fitted models. It excludes variation from the ET training seed and from the multistart RNG. The interval lower bound (about 0.728 relative) is far above the 0.01 margin, so this is unlikely to flip the verdict. Still, report results across at least a few seeds, or explicitly scope the claim as conditional on seed 0.
objections.author: critic-002

objections.requirement: Data are generated by the same simulator used for inversion: same 40-point grid, 200 explicit steps, known initial condition and known noise model. Physics-arm superiority is therefore an 'inverse crime' result under a perfectly specified forward model. Synthesis must scope the claim to the well-specified setting and not generalize to model misspecification, unknown initial conditions, or different discretizations.
objections.author: critic-002

objections.requirement: The control is one untuned extra_trees configuration on raw features, with no noise augmentation and no PCA. Synthesis must not generalize the result to 'forward-model inversion beats library regressors'. The supported claim is limited to this specific ET configuration.
objections.author: critic-002

Second, a comparison of per-target error against the local Fisher / Cramér–Rao scale at sigma=0.001, to tell noise-limited error from local-minimum or non-convergence failures. Include a list of rows where the best of the 3 starts did not converge. Per the contract, Fisher results are local diagnostics only.
objections.author: critic-002

objections.requirement: Report the actual number of forward evaluations used by the physics and hybrid arms, in total and per row. Confirm the total is within max_forward_evals=3,000,000. Report wall-clock cost alongside accuracy, since the hybrid (about 27.3 s estimated) costs more than physics (about 17.3 s) with no measurable accuracy gain.
objections.author: critic-002

objections.requirement: Document that iters (30 and 15), multistart=3 and extra_starts=1 were fixed before the validation results were seen. Confirm that no test or stress observations informed any choice. If any settings were tuned on validation, the 750 validation rows are not an unbiased estimate, and a held-out confirmation is needed before final claims.

objections.requirement: No claim comparing the hybrid against the physics arm is registered or tested. Their difference (about 7e-6 in rel_l2) has no interval. Synthesis must not rank the two treatments against each other.

objections.requirement: Implementation verification is missing for all three claims, and each claim sets requires_implementation_verification=true. In every arm the method_contract shows diagnostics.verified=false, the declared and observed diagnostic lists are empty, and source_hash=null. The inference_policy says repeatability requires exported-artifact certification, and none is supplied. objections.author: critic-002

objections.requirement: The registered question asks whether the hybrid is equivalent 'while using fewer forward evaluations', but no forward-evaluation counts, wall-clock times, or Jacobian-evaluation counts are reported for either arm. The est_seconds values (17.3 for physics_mle, 27.3 for hybrid_lm) are gate estimates, not measurements, and they suggest the hybrid may cost more. Report the measured forward-eval count per row (mean and max) for physics_mle and hybrid_lm. Until then, no synthesis may claim a compute advantage; C-Q1-002.hybrid_equiv_physics can only support accuracy equivalence.
objections.author: critic-002

objections.requirement: Attribution of the hybrid result to the ET initializer is unsupported. The hybrid's per-sample squared errors match physics_mle to about 1e-9 (for example, 0.0017367219887 vs 0.0017367224577) and its per-target RMSEs match to 4 digits. This indicates that both arms converge to the same likelihood optimum regardless of initialization. No ablation is supplied, such as LM with 15 iterations and 2 random or prior-mean starts and no ET init, so the contribution of the ET init is unidentified. Any synthesis implying that the data-driven init improves accuracy is unsupported.
objections.author: critic-002

objections.requirement: Init provenance cannot be verified. C-Q1-002.hybrid states that the initializer uses the 'same configuration and seed as the control'. The configuration hash matches the control (170e334e...), but the hybrid's source_artifacts (resu-00145, resu-00141) do not show that the fitted init model is the same artifact as control_et. Provide the fitted-model identifier or hash used inside hybrid_lm.
objections.author: critic-002

objections.requirement: No optimizer convergence diagnostics are reported for the MLE label. Missing items include the final objective or chi-square per row compared with its expected value (about 80·sigma² = 8e-5 for 80 observations at sigma=0.001), gradient or step norms at termination, the fraction of rows hitting the 30- or 15-iteration cap, the fraction of estimates at the [0.5, 2.0] bounds, and the agreement among the 3 starts. Without these, 'maximum-likelihood' is asserted rather than demonstrated, and local minima cannot be ruled out.
objections.author: critic-002

objections.requirement: There is no efficiency reference against local Fisher information. Per-target RMSE is about 5x larger for the outer segments (0.0356 and 0.0350) than for the inner ones (0.0079 and 0.0065). This is consistent with weaker sensitivity near the Dirichlet boundaries, but it is not checked against a local Fisher/Cramér-Rao bound under sigma=0.001. Per the contract, any such comparison is local only and is not an identifiability guarantee. Without it, the evidence cannot separate estimator suboptimality from intrinsic ill-conditioning.
objections.author: critic-002

objections.requirement: The control is a single untuned ExtraTrees configuration (max_features=0.5, 300 trees, raw features, no noise augmentation, no PCA). The about-75% relative improvement supports only the claim as registered against this specific baseline. Any synthesis generalizing to 'physics inversion beats data-driven methods' would need tuned, stronger, or noise-augmented data-driven controls.
objections.author: critic-002

objections.requirement: The inverse-crime scope must be carried into synthesis. Data generation and inversion share the exact 40-point, 200-step explicit FD forward model and the exact known noise sigma. The claim texts state this scope. Any synthesis must not extend the conclusions to model misspecification, grid mismatch, unknown noise level, or real data, because no stress evidence under misspecification is supplied and held-out stress data cannot be used for this.
objections.author: critic-002

objections.requirement: Uncertainty scope is limited. The bootstrap intervals use n_bootstrap=200, cover only row resampling conditional on fitted models, and exclude training and task seed variation. The seed-1 replicate covers only ET and physics_mle (physics 0.019337 vs 0.019323, ET 0.07711 vs 0.07741), and no seed-1 hybrid arm exists. The margins are far from the intervals, so the verdicts are unlikely to change. Still, the equivalence claim should note that hybrid seed variability is unmeasured, and a larger bootstrap is advisable for tail quantiles.
objections.author: critic-002

objections.requirement: Previously raised objections are not visible here. The verdicts list objection-016 through 022, 024, and 029 as unresolved blocking requirements, but their content and resolution status are not part of the supplied evidence. A verdict update requires explicit resolution records for each of them, and this review cannot adjudicate them.
objections.author: critic-002

objections.requirement: The per-target diagnostics are incomplete for a comparison. S-Q1-002.per_target_physics and per_target_hybrid report per_target_rel_l2 only for the treatment, for example [0.0268, 0.0060, 0.0050, 0.0263]. They give no matching control per-target rel_l2 or per-target paired intervals, so the claim that improvement holds on every target is not directly evidenced. The per_target_rmse values in the paired diagnostics do suggest it does, but without intervals.
objections.author: critic-002

objections.requirement: Implementation verification is still absent for every S-Q1-002 arm, and all three claims set requires_implementation_verification=true. Each arm shows source_hash=null and method_contract.diagnostics.verified=false with empty declared and observed lists. Each result artifact shows verification.intervention_verified=false and diagnostic_gates_verified=false. Passing the finite and shape checks is not verification. Before any claim leaves 'inconclusive', supply three things: source hashes for the physics, LM and hybrid code; exported-artifact certification; and an independent noiseless round-trip that recovers known k to solver tolerance. This keeps objections 016, 032 and 042 open.
objections.author: critic-002

objections.requirement: Convergence is contradicted, not just undocumented. Every inversion artifact reports last_iters equal to its cap: 30 for physics_mle, physics_mle_seed1 and S-Q1-001.physics_map, and 15 for both hybrid runs. So at least the last solve batch ran to the iteration limit. Report the per-row iterations-used distribution and the fraction of rows at the cap, for the selected start and for all starts. Report the gradient or step norm at termination and final chi2 versus chi2 at true k for the same rows. Until then, 'maximum-likelihood' describes the objective, not the estimate obtained (objections 022 and 046).
objections.author: critic-002

objections.requirement: The forward-evaluation counts do not reconcile with the stated design and need an explicit breakdown. physics_mle used 174,716 evals over 750 rows, about 233 per row. The nominal 3 starts × 30 iterations × (1 residual + 4 finite-difference Jacobian solves) would be 450 per row, or 337,500 total. hybrid_lm used about 138 per row against a nominal 2 × 15 × 5 = 150, so it is close to nominal while physics is at about 52%. Possible explanations include per-row early termination (which conflicts with last_iters=cap), a non-FD Jacobian, shared or batched solves, or uncounted calls. Provide per-row residual, Jacobian, rejected-step and start counts, and state which forward calls the counter excludes. The executor's totals may count as partial evidence for objection 020, but the split and this discrepancy must be resolved before the counts support any efficiency statement.
objections.author: critic-002

objections.requirement: The uncertainty procedure does not meet the decision rule registered in objections 019 and 002. Every paired diagnostic uses n_bootstrap=200. Each reports a relative_effect interval at an unstated confidence level, with no Bonferroni adjustment across the three claims and no ratio-scale interval. Task-004 was asked for B=2000, all four pairs, and 95% plus 98.33% ratio intervals, but it returned a single B=200 pair. For the at_least_better claims, the effect is far from the margin, so this is unlikely to change the outcome, but the registered procedure was still not followed. For C-Q1-002.hybrid_equiv_physics, the TOST-style equivalence decision has not been computed at the adjusted level: the reported interval is [-0.00126, 0.00021] relative, at an unknown level, from 200 resamples. Provide B≥2000 ratio intervals at 95% and 98.33% for every pair.
objections.author: critic-002

objections.requirement: Provenance of the seed-1 physics arm is unresolved. resu-00140 is labelled exp-0013 but has cached=true, reused_result_exp_id=exp-0008, wall_seconds=0.0 and device=cpu. Its pred and idx paths point to exp-0008, which predates S-Q1-002's experiments (exp-0009 to exp-0012) and so predates the study's registration. Show what produced exp-0008, with which seed and configuration. Confirm that its 175,409 forward evals are counted once, not as new S-Q1-002 spend. Note also that the seed change is confounded with a device change (cpu versus gpu0 for seed 0). No seed-variability statement for physics can rest on this arm until this is resolved.
objections.author: critic-002

objections.requirement: The stop and synthesis text misstates the ET seed variation by about 10×. It says the seed-1 replicates move rel_l2 'by less than 0.0004 relative for ET'. The measured values are 0.077407 versus 0.077108, a relative change of 0.0039, or 0.39% of rel_l2 and about 39% of the 1% margin. The physics figure (0.019323 versus 0.019337, about 0.00075 relative) is stated correctly. Correct the synthesis. Do not describe ET seed variation as negligible relative to the margin.
objections.author: critic-002

objections.requirement: Held-out leakage audit. researcher-003's final Q-1 message and objections 024, 049 and the code_rules spec are redacted as '[redacted: held-out evidence]'. This means research-agent content touched held-out material. The contract says final test and stress observations cannot inform research decisions. Before any verdict or export, provide an audit showing that no test-split observation, metric or fingerprint-linked result influenced arm selection, study revision or the stop decision.
objections.author: critic-002

objections.requirement: Hybrid initializer identity (objection 021) is still unverified. The configuration hash matches the control (170e334e…), but the hybrid reports a separate initializer_fit_seconds of 4.38 s. That indicates the ET was refit inside the hybrid rather than shared with control_et (exp-0009). Report the max absolute difference between the hybrid's val initializer predictions and exp-0009/val_pred.npy, or a fitted-model hash. Until then, C-Q1-002.hybrid does not isolate the effect of LM refinement.
objections.author: critic-002

objections.requirement: Handling of failed rows and bounds (objections 017, 018 and 023). All arms show n_finite=750 and failed_arms is empty. This shows every row received a finite prediction, but it does not show that the solves were valid. A clip or projection fallback would produce finite outputs that hide unstable or failed solves. Report the declared fallback rule. Report the count of rows whose prediction lies within 1e-6 of log 0.5 or log 2.0. Report the count of NaN or Inf forward outputs during trial steps. Report the CFL ratio dt·k_max/dx² at k=2.0 and the maximum k evaluated before projection. The finite-count evidence can partly resolve 018 only once the fallback rule is stated.
objections.author: critic-002

objections.requirement: Scope the forward-fidelity spot check. fit_report shows residual_std_at_truth=9.95e-4 and model_mismatch=false on checked_samples=200, with the same value in every artifact. The evidence does not state whether these 200 rows are val or train rows. Identify the split and row indices. Note that this check shows consistency between the data and the forward model at the true k on those rows. It does not verify the inversion's forward call: it says nothing about the face-averaging rule, the segment-to-cell map, or Jacobian parity.
objections.author: critic-002

objections.requirement: An efficiency claim is not supported by a matched design. The stop text asserts that the hybrid 'uses about 41% fewer forward evaluations per row at equivalent rel_l2'. The arms differ in starts (2 versus 3), iteration cap (15 versus 30), and initialization (ET versus prior or random). No physics arm with 2 starts × 15 iterations and no ET initialization exists. The saving therefore cannot be attributed to the ET initializer, and no efficiency comparison is a registered claim. Synthesis may report the raw counts (103,235 versus 174,716) and predict times (8.4 s versus 15.2 s; ET fit adds about 4.4 s) descriptively only. Objections 043 and 044 still apply.
objections.author: critic-002

objections.requirement: S-Q1-002 is not an independent replication of S-Q1-001. The physics and hybrid arms reproduce S-Q1-001 exactly: identical rel_l2 to every reported digit, identical forward_evals (174,716 and 103,235), and identical per-row error summaries. They differ only in cache_key and device. Synthesis must treat S-Q1-002 as a deterministic re-evaluation under corrected matching, not as additional confirmatory evidence. The disclosure of the post-hoc protocol deviation requested in objection 030 still applies to S-Q1-002's re-registration.
objections.author: critic-002

objections.requirement: The control is weak and unrepresentative of Q-1 as asked. Q-1 asks about 'the best library regressor (e.g. extra_trees / torch_mlp)'. Only one untuned ET configuration ran. That ET reaches train rel_l2 1.46e-15, which is full memorization, against val 0.0774. No tuned, noise-augmented, PCA or MLP control exists. Synthesis may state only that the result holds against this ET configuration. It must not answer Q-1 as 'beats the best library regressor' (objections 037 and 048).
objections.author: critic-002

objections.requirement: Q-2 is only half addressed and lacks its local reference. The per-target rel_l2 values are physics [0.0268, 0.0060, 0.0050, 0.0263] and ET [0.117, 0.028, 0.029, 0.092]. They show that outer-segment error is larger, but they are point estimates without intervals or matched control per-target paired intervals. No Tikhonov or multistart-count ablation was executed, so the second half of Q-2 is untested. No local CRLB at sigma=0.001 was computed, so noise-limited error cannot be separated from optimizer failure. Synthesis must not answer the regularization or multistart part of Q-2. Any identifiability statement must be labelled local, empirical and descriptive.
objections.author: critic-002

objections.requirement: The role of posterior_samples=128 when estimator='mode' is still undocumented (objections 025 and 034). The artifacts report uncertainty summaries: mean_std 0.0190, 1σ coverage 0.703, 2σ coverage 0.957, z_rms 0.983. So sampling or a Laplace approximation is being computed, and whether it enters the point estimate is unknown. Also, coverage and calibration are not registered claims, so synthesis should present them as unverified descriptive diagnostics only.
objections.author: critic-002

objections.requirement: Artifact bookkeeping needs reconciling before evidence can be cited for resolution. Task-004 lists artifact_id resu-00163, but its result carries artifact_id resu-00162 with id=null. Specialist tasks 001 and 003 failed with unmeasured forward spend. The stop text says 'all five diagnostics', but S-Q1-002 registers six (five required and one optional). Correct these records, and carry the spend of the failed tasks as unmeasured in the budget ledger.
objections.author: critic-002

objections.requirement: Objection 029 (certification) can be addressed by evidence: evidence_ids are now populated and the verdicts were issued by the harness verifier. To resolve it, cite resu-00155 and the per-claim verdict records explicitly, and confirm that no researcher text was used as verdict input. Being resolvable does not lift the remaining blocking implementation objections.
